goal: Replace ideal spatially unbounded inverse Maxwell drive with bounded, physically sourced fields while preserving trajectory predictions
requirements: Specify a bounded apparatus geometry and actual coil or source current density with boundary conditions
Compute Maxwell fields from the source instead of defining the fields from the desired trajectory
Check Maxwell divergence and curl identities numerically in the whole bounded domain
Include source supports, external power, Poynting flux and electromagnetic stress-energy
Integrate the charged test-particle trajectory including physically relevant radiation reaction
Measure or simulate perturbation growth and determine stability control
Specify independently calibratable coil current, voltage and field gradient
Ensure field and source energy are finite; compare practical engineering power budget
Treat field-line knots, trajectories, and propagating EM waves as different observables
acceptance: No root claim of a natural universal law until a source-first finite-energy calculation and an independently measurable prediction exist
